subject: Renewal discussion: prompt-eval & labeling services + pilot scope
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@annotate.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal notice + SOW for prompt-eval & labeling (June start)

Hi Neha / Rishi,

Hope you both are well — quick heads up that our annual contract for prompt evaluation and labeling services with Redwood is coming up for renewal on June 15. I attached version 3 of the proposed SOW with updated pricing (minor adjustments for higher-quality control) and a suggested pilot/canary scope so we can validate the new interleaving workflow you described at the workshop.

Key highlights in the SOW:
- Pilot: 50k prompt-response pairs, 3 annotator passes, per-item adjudication on disagreements.
- Production: per-1k-unit pricing tiers, SLA for turnaround (48h standard, 12h expedited).
- Security: option for VPC connector or customer-hosted S3 ingestion.

Attachments: [AnnotateAI_SOW_v3.pdf]

Can we schedule a 30-min call next week to walk through the items we flagged (SLA, data residency, sample deliverables)? Our legal team is ready to review the small redlines.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Strategic Accounts, AnnotateAI
[sara@annotate.ai]

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@annotate.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + SOW for prompt-eval & labeling (June start)

Sara — thanks for the SOW and the overview. I skimmed v3; some high-level questions before we book time: 

1) Pricing: Your per-1k tiers changed vs last year. Can you confirm the effective price for the pilot (50k units) and what discounts apply if we commit to a 6-month volume? We need both list and committed-rate options.

2) SLAs: 48h standard turnaround is fine for most jobs, but our product team will want an explicit error/quality SLA and remedy (credits or rework) if label accuracy drops below agreed thresholds. Can you add measurable QA metrics (precision/recall or agreement rates) and a remediation path?

3) Data handling: We prefer the VPC connector + customer encryption keys. Your SOW mentions optional on-prem ingestion — need more detail on that path and costs.

4) Sample outputs: before a full renewal, we want a 1k sample deliverable that uses our prompt templates and includes the adjudication trace (annotator comments). Can you confirm you can produce an export matching our Labeling_Quality_Metrics.xlsx schema?

Attaching our internal metrics template we’ll use for acceptance. Also looping in Rishi to handle commercials.

Attachments: [Labeling_Quality_Metrics.xlsx]

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@annotate.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-03T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + SOW for prompt-eval & labeling (June start)

Quick note from commercial side — we can do a 6-month commit at the discounted tier if AnnotateAI can meet the following: 
- Pilot pricing locked at $0.65 per 1k units (pilot only) or equivalent credit towards commit.
- 12h expedited SLA must be available for critical batches with a capped surcharge (no more than 1.5x).
- Acceptance criteria: pass rate >= 92% agreement on gold-label prompts in pilot.

If you can sign to those terms, we’ll move procurement and legal to draft an amendment. Can you also provide your most recent SOC2 report and the confirmation that annotator access is restricted and audited?

Thanks — Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(On a logistics note: tentative call Wed 5/6 at 10am PT?)

From: Sara Lim <sara@annotate.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-06T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + SOW for prompt-eval & labeling (June start)

On Wed, May 6, 2026 at 08:00 AnnotateAI Internal Calendar wrote:
> Scheduled: Renewal SOW walkthrough — Wed 5/6 10:00am PT

Neha / Rishi — great to confirm the call. Short answers inline: 
- Pilot pricing: we can set pilot at $0.60 per 1k units if Redwood commits to the 6-month review and shares usage projections within 2 weeks of signing. Pilot credits will apply to the first-month invoice of production.
- Expedited SLA: 12h for critical batches is possible; surcharge at 1.4x. We’ll include a capped monthly expedited quota so costs are predictable.
- Acceptance: we’ll run the 1k sample and provide adjudication logs. Agree to include the 92% agreement gate for pilot acceptance.
- SOC2: attaching the latest report and the signed NDA we have on file. Annotator access is role-based with MFA and audited activity logs.

Attachments: [SOC2-Report-2025.pdf, NDA_signed_AnnotateAI.pdf]

We’ve also uploaded a DocuSign package for the small SOW redlines (link below). If legal wants to push back, happy to route through our counsel for triage.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/xyz1234

See you on the call,
Sara

Subject: Internal: AnnotateAI renewal pilot — next steps and PO request

Team — recap and asks after vendor call:

Recap: AnnotateAI accepts the pilot pricing at $0.60/1k for the 50k pilot if we provide usage projections. They will honor 12h expedited SLA with 1.4x surcharge and agreed to the 92% agreement gate for acceptance. Vendor provided SOC2 and NDA (attached in thread).

Immediate asks: 
- Procurement: please start a requisition and draft a PO for the pilot (estimate: $30k at pilot rate plus a $2k buffer for expedited surcharges). We’ll convert to a 6-month committed contract if pilot passes.
- Dev: please prepare the ingestion ACLs and a short S3 bucket with read-only credentials for AnnotateAI. Vendor prefers VPC connector but can fall back to presigned S3. We need this by 5/20.
- Marissa: can you run the sample acceptance run and evaluate against Labeling_Quality_Metrics.xlsx when it arrives? Expect deliverable ~72 hours after data handoff.

Forwarding AnnotateAI SOW and SOC2 — I’ll sign off on the pilot PO once procurement confirms the payment method.

Attachments: [AnnotateAI_SOW_v3.pdf, SOC2-Report-2025.pdf, Labeling_Quality_Metrics.xlsx]

Thanks — Neha
